description: This file defines the Gridlines class, which represents gridlines on axes in the PDFsharp Charting library. It includes constructors, a clone method, deep copy implementation, and a property for line formatting.

classes.name: Gridlines
classes.description: Represents the gridlines on axes in the chart, providing cloning and deep copy capabilities, and managing line formatting.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Gridlines object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the object, including cloning of the line format if it exists.
